blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro or lazy days on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar, Tanzania offers it all. The good news: Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary around all of your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. A lot of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s loveliest beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whatever you decide, one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or a journey adjusted to your own ideas, we are ready to help. Join us and get set to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide will be waiting for you on arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He then takes you to your hotel so you can recover from the journey.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before you set off you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on what to wear and what to pack, plus other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: Our guide meets you at your hotel in the morning to take you to Londorossi Gate, on the west side, where your unforgettable Kilimanjaro climb begins! After completing registration and the necessary ascent permit formalities, you head to the first camp on the route: Big Tree Camp. Be sure to bring your rain jacket, as you have to cross a part of rainforest. After lunch, enjoy an acclimatization hike to Shira 1 Camp, gaining 300 meters in elevation, before returning to Big Tree Camp for dinner.
blocks.html: In the morning our guide collects you from your hotel and drives you to Londorossi Gate on the west side, the starting point of your unforgettable Kilimanjaro climb! Once registration and the required ascent permit paperwork are done, you set out for Big Tree Camp, the first camp on the route. Make sure your rain jacket is close at hand, because part of the way crosses rainforest. After lunch you go on an acclimatization hike to Shira 1 Camp, climbing 300 meters, and then return to Big Tree Camp for dinner.

blocks.orig: An early morning wake-up call, followed by breakfast, sets the stage for a gradual ascent to 3,505 meters, offering a breathtaking first view of the Shira Plateau and Kibo Volcano. The hike to Shira 1 high mountain camp is relatively easy, taking about 5-6 hours, which aids in the crucial acclimatization process, a key aspect of successful trekking. Upon reaching the camp, lunch is served, with the option to either rest in your tent or take a walk in the surrounding area.
blocks.html: You are woken early and, after breakfast, begin a gradual climb to 3,505 meters, where you get a stunning first look at Kibo Volcano and the Shira Plateau. The hike to the high mountain camp of Shira 1 is fairly easy and takes around 5-6 hours, which helps with acclimatization, an essential part of a successful trek. Lunch is waiting when you reach the camp, and afterwards you can rest in your tent or go for a walk around the area.

blocks.orig: Today you trek from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp. This walk is not difficult and you can enjoy the amazing landscapes and the unique flora of Kilimanjaro's surroundings as you climb higher. On a clear day, Shira 2 Camp is the perfect location to see Mount Meru (the fifth peak of Africa). After lunch, take an acclimatization walk to Lava Tower Camp (elevation gain of 200m) to increase the chances to summit and reduce the chances of altitude sickness.
blocks.html: Today's trek takes you from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp. It is not a hard walk, and while you gain height you can enjoy the wonderful scenery and the special plant life around Kilimanjaro. When the weather is clear, Shira 2 Camp is an ideal place for seeing Mount Meru (Africa's fifth peak). After lunch an acclimatization walk to Lava Tower Camp (200m of elevation gain) improves your chance of reaching the summit and lowers the risk of altitude sickness.

blocks.orig: The Lemosho route joins the Machame route today. The hike leads from Shira Camp 2 to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). This part of the climb has many ascents and descents, but offers magnificent views along the way. It is a long hike and you may start to feel a bit uncomfortable because of the height. It is therefore important to find the right pace in order for your body to adjust to the altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp at the foot of Barranco Wall.
blocks.html: Today the Lemosho route merges with the Machame route. You hike from Shira Camp 2 to the striking Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). This section goes up and down a great deal, yet rewards you with superb views along the way. It is a long day and the altitude may begin to make you feel a little unwell. That is why finding the right pace matters, so your body can adapt to the height. After lunch you go down to Barranco Camp, at the base of Barranco Wall.

blocks.orig: After breakfast you depart from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. For many people, this is their favorite part of the climb. Once at the top of the Barranco Wall, you have a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Once breakfast is over you set off from Barranco Camp towards the Barranco Wall. Plenty of climbers consider this the highlight of the whole climb. From the top of the Barranco Wall the view of Mount Meru and the Kibo Volcano is spectacular.

blocks.orig: Afterwards, a more difficult hike starts to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: Then a harder hike begins, taking you to Karanga Camp. The trail climbs and drops repeatedly, so be sure to keep a sensible pace. Lunch is at the camp, and once you have rested you can go on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: Today, you hike to Barafu Camp (once breakfast is done, of course!). This camp is the starting point for your ascent to Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870 m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: Today, after breakfast of course, you hike on to Barafu Camp. From here you start your ascent to Uhuru Peak, the summit of Kilimanjaro! You reach the camp at about lunchtime. Rest for a while, and when you have your energy back, do an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870 m) and return. Take in the magnificent views of the peaks around you and enjoy the excitement of camping at high altitude as you get ready for the final summit push at around midnight.

blocks.orig: The big day is finally here! Around midnight, the ascent from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak begins. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a quick celebration at the top (because, hey, you just conquered Kilimanjaro!), you start a slow descent to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: At last the big day has arrived! At about midnight you begin the climb from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the real challenge is the high altitude. On the summit a beautiful sunrise awaits you, which is truly impressive from this height! After a short celebration at the top (you have just conquered Kilimanjaro, after all!), you slowly make your way down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millenium camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to Mweka Gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park.
blocks.html: Millenium camp lies within tropical rainforest. Waking up today, you feel relief at being lower down and satisfaction at having reached the summit. After breakfast an easy walk takes you to Mweka Gate, where you leave Kilimanjaro National Park.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest. Unforgettable memories, breathtaking views, and a true sense of accomplishment await and will stay forever with you!
blocks.html: Afterwards your driver takes you back to the hotel for some well-earned rest. You take home unforgettable memories, stunning views and a real feeling of achievement that will stay with you for ever!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday is over and it is time to return home. Enjoy your final hours in Tanzania until our driver picks you up and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for the flight back. Would you like more? You can also add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
